title.zh: 儿童帐篷游戏屋插珠拼搭套装
title.en: Kids Tent Playhouse Bead Building Set

summary.zh:
这是一款面向跨境渠道的儿童帐篷游戏屋插珠拼搭套装，适用于家庭互动、活动空间搭建和课堂游戏场景，可组合多种结构形态。

品牌为其他，材质为塑料/塑胶，产地东莞茶山，主要适配eBay、亚马逊和速卖通等平台销售。
summary.en:
This is a cross-border oriented kids tent playhouse bead-building set for family interaction, activity-space setup, and classroom game scenarios, with flexible structure combinations.

Brand: Other. Material: plastic. Origin: Chashan, Dongguan. It is mainly positioned for platforms such as eBay, Amazon, and AliExpress.

zh: 该款儿童帐篷游戏屋插珠拼搭套装采用杆件与连接球组合结构，可用于搭建帐篷、房屋与游戏空间，适合家庭和活动场景中的互动玩法。
产品主材为塑料/塑胶，支持多次拆装和重构。主要面向跨境电商渠道，覆盖欧洲、南美、东南亚、北美和中东等区域市场。
商品采用彩盒包装，包装重量3200g。该条目中的“专利及著作权申请时间”源数据为异常值，已按原始信息保留为未标注说明。
en: This kids tent playhouse bead set uses rods and connector balls to build tents, house-like structures, and interactive play spaces for home and event scenarios.

The product is made of plastic and supports repeated assembly and reconfiguration. It is mainly positioned for cross-border e-commerce channels across Europe, South America, Southeast Asia, North America, and the Middle East.
Packed in a color box with a 3200g package weight. The original patent filing-time field contains an abnormal source value and is retained as unspecified for data integrity.
